blocks.text: Vertebrates (reerh ki haddi wale janwar) do groups mein baante gaye hain:

items: Group Pisces: is mein 3 classes hain: Cyclostomata, Chondrichthyes aur Osteichthyes. Yeh machhliyan hain aur in ke limbs (haath paon) nahi hote.
Group Tetrapoda: is mein 4 classes hain: Amphibia, Reptilia, Aves aur Mammalia. In ke chaar limbs hote hain.

blocks.alt: Ek chart. Vertebrates do groups mein batte hain. Pisces (limbs nahi) mein teen classes: Cyclostomata, Chondrichthyes, Osteichthyes. Tetrapoda (chaar limbs) mein chaar classes: Amphibia, Reptilia, Aves, Mammalia.
blocks.caption: Vertebrates ki saat classes apne do groups mein (asal chart).
blocks.long_description: Machhliyan group Pisces banati hain: jabre ke baghair machhliyan, cartilage wali machhliyan aur haddi wali machhliyan. Chaar limbs wali classes group Tetrapoda banati hain: amphibians, reptiles, parinde aur mammals.

blocks.text: 1. Class Cyclostomata

Yeh jawless (jabron ke baghair) machhliyan hain. Lampreys aur hagfish aam misaalein hain. In ka jism eel (baam machhli) jaisa hota hai aur us par scales (chhilke) nahi hote. Skeleton cartilage (narm haddi) ka hota hai. Doosri machhliyon ki tarah in ka dil single-circuit hai, jis mein ek atrium aur ek ventricle hota hai. Fertilization jism ke bahar (external) hoti hai.
2. Class Chondrichthyes

Is group mein sharks, skates, rays aur ratfishes aate hain. In ka skeleton cartilage ka hota hai. Jism par placoid (daant jaise) scales hote hain jinhein denticles kehte hain. In ke jabre (jaws) aur kaatne wale mouthparts hote hain. Pectoral aur pelvic fins joron mein hote hain, aur do dorsal fins hote hain. Dil single-circuit hai, ek atrium aur ek ventricle ke saath. Aankhon ke peeche chhote soorakhon ka ek jora hota hai jise spiracle kehte hain; yeh saans lene ke kaam aate hain. In mein swim bladder nahi hota. Fertilization jism ke andar (internal) hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Shark pehlu se: do dorsal fins, caudal fin, anal fin, pelvic fin, pectoral fin, sar ke peeche paanch gill slits aur aankh ke peeche spiracle. Neeche gol khaane mein jild ka ek tukra bara kar ke daant jaise denticles dikhaye gaye hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.21: Cartilaginous fishes (kitab ki Figure 1.21 ke mutabiq shark ka asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Shark ki jild par placoid scales hote hain jinhein denticles kehte hain; bara kiya hua gol khaana dikhata hai ke yeh chhote daanton jaise hain. Gill slits par koi dhakkan (operculum) nahi hota, is liye bahar se saaf dikhte hain. Spiracle aankh ke peeche ek chhota soorakh hai jo saans mein madad karta hai. Pectoral aur pelvic fins jore (paired) mein hain.
3. Class Osteichthyes

Bony fishes (haddi wali machhliyon) mein haddi ka endoskeleton, streamlined (paani ko kaatne wala) jism, jild ke haddi wale (dermal bony) scales, aur saamne (terminal) mouth hota hai jis mein jabre hote hain (daanton ke saath ya baghair). Notochord ki jagah vertebral column aa jata hai, lekin kuch bony fishes mein notochord chhoti shakal mein reh jata hai. In mein swim bladder hota hai jo buoyancy (paani mein tairte rehne) mein madad karta hai. In mein median fins (dorsal, caudal aur ventral, yani beech ki line wale) aur paired fins (pelvic aur pectoral, yani joron wale) dono hote hain. Gills ke chaar jore hote hain, aur haddi ka ek hifazati dhakkan, operculum, gills ko dhaanpta hai. Nervous system achhi tarah bana hai, jis mein cranial nerves ke das jore hote hain. Fertilization zyada tar external hoti hai. Meethe paani ki bony fishes: rohu, trout, katla, catfish wagaira. Samandari bony fishes: seahorse, flying fish aur angler fish wagaira.

blocks.alt: Haddi wali machhli (perch jaisi) ki andar ki banawat, pehlu se: dorsal, caudal, pelvic aur anal fins; sar mein eye, nostril aur brain; aadhe kate operculum ke neeche gills; gills ke peeche heart aur liver; peeth ke saath spinal cord, kidney aur swim bladder; pait mein stomach, intestine, gonad, urinary bladder aur anus.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.22: Haddi wali machhliyon ki numainda misaalein aur aam banawat (kitab ki Figure 1.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; sirf aam banawat).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Operculum gills ko dhaanpne wala haddi ka dhakkan hai; khaake mein us ka kuch hissa kaat kar neeche gills dikhaye gaye hain. Neela lamba thaila swim bladder hai jis mein gas bhar kar machhli paani mein upar neeche rehti hai (buoyancy). Shark ke baraks yahan gills bahar se nazar nahi aate. Dorsal, caudal aur anal fins akele (median) hain; pelvic fins jore mein hain.

blocks.caption: Machhliyon ki teen classes ka muqabla (comparison)

blocks.text: 4. Class Amphibia

Yeh tetrapods ki pehli class hai. In mein haddi ka endoskeleton hota hai. Machhliyon ke baraks amphibians ki gardan (neck) hoti hai: pehla vertebra (cervical vertebra) khopri ke pichhle hisse ke saath harkat karta hai aur khopri ko upar neeche hilne deta hai. Jild hamwar (scales ke baghair) aur nam hoti hai. Yeh gases ke tabadle, temperature control, aur paani jazb karne aur jama rakhne mein madad karti hai. Dil double-circuit aur teen chambers wala hai: do atria aur ek ventricle. Larva ki stage mein yeh gills se, aur baalig ho kar lungs aur jild se saans lete hain. Yeh garmi ke liye bahar ke zariye (external heat source) par chalte hain, is liye ectotherms hain. Yeh apne jism ka temperature control nahi kar sakte aur use ek jaisa nahi rakh sakte; is liye yeh poikilothermic (badalte temperature wale) janwar hain aur sardiyon mein hibernate karte hain (lambi neend so jate hain). Salamander, newts aur mud puppies dum wale amphibians hain; mendak (frogs) aur toads bina dum ke; aur caecilians bina taangon ke. Amphibians unisexual hain. Fertilization aam taur par external hoti hai.
5. Class Reptilia

Reptiles janwaron ka pehla group hain jin mein amniotic eggs hote hain. Amniotic egg hifazati extra-embryonic membranes (embryo ke bahar ki jhilliyan) banata hai: amnion, allantois aur chorion. Yeh membranes embryo ko sookhne se bachati hain, use ghiza deti hain aur zameen par develop hone deti hain. Amniotic egg mein bohat sa yolk (zardi) hota hai, jo embryo ki asal khurak hai. Is mein kaafi albumin (safedi) bhi hoti hai, jo mazeed ghiza aur paani deti hai. Amniotic egg par chamre jaisa (leathery) aur calcium wala (calcareous) khol hota hai, jis mein se gases kuch had tak guzar sakti hain lekin paani nahi.

blocks.alt: Amniotic egg (anda) kat kar: shell ke andar chorion poore ande ko gherti hai. Mura hua embryo ek fluid bhari thaili, amnion, mein hai. Bari peeli yolk sac aur hari allantois dono dandiyon se embryo se juri hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.24: Amniotic egg (kitab ki Figure 1.24 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Amnion embryo ke gird ek jhilli (membrane) hai; us ke andar ka fluid embryo ko sookhne aur jhatkon se bachata hai. Yolk sac (peeli) mein ghiza hai. Allantois (hari) fuzla jama karti hai aur chorion ke saath mil kar gas exchange mein madad karti hai. Chorion sab se bahar wali jhilli hai jo shell ke andar poore ande ko gherti hai. Shell se gases guzar sakti hain lekin paani nahi.

blocks.alt: Ek anda kaat kar us ki tehain dikhai gayi hain. Ek taraf se bahar ka khol hataya gaya hai. Andar, chorion khol ke saath lagi hai; embryo fluid se bhari thaili, amnion, mein hai; embryo ke neeche bara yolk sac zardi rakhta hai; us ke saath doosri thaili, allantois, hai; thailiyon aur khol ke darmiyan saaf albumin bhari hai.
blocks.caption: Amniotic egg (Figure 1.24 ke mutabiq asal 3D model).
blocks.long_description: Bahar se andar ki taraf: khol (shell); chorion, sab se bahar wali membrane; albumin; amnion, jo embryo ko fluid mein ghere hue hai; yolk sac, embryo ki ghiza; aur allantois, ek thaili jo fuzla (waste) jama karti hai aur gason ka tabadla karti hai. Yeh membranes reptile, parinde ya mammal ke embryo ko paani se door develop hone deti hain.

blocks.text: Reptiles ki jild khushk aur scales wali hoti hai. In ka haddi ka endoskeleton amphibians se zyada sakht hota hai, aur khopri amphibians se lambi hoti hai. Reptiles mein pehle do cervical vertebrae (atlas aur axis) sar ko zyada harkat dete hain. Dil mein ventricle baayein aur daayein ventricles mein adhoora (incompletely) bata hota hai.

Amphibians ki tarah reptiles bhi ectothermic hain aur jism ka temperature control karne (thermoregulation) ke liye bahar ki garmi istemal karte hain. Yeh jism ka temperature ek jaisa nahi rakh sakte, is liye poikilotherms hain. Fertilization internal hai. Yeh oviparous (ande dene wale) hain. Aaj ke reptiles: lizards (chhipkaliyan), snakes (saanp), tuatara aur crocodiles (magarmachh).
6. Class Aves

Birds (parindon) ke jism par feathers (par) hote hain. Feathers urne ki satah banate hain jo lift (upar uthne ki taqat) deti hai aur rukh badalne mein madad karti hai. Feathers garmi aur paani ko zaya hone se bhi rokte hain. Birds endotherms hain, yani apne cells ke processes se garmi hasil karte hain. Andar ki is garmi se yeh jism ke andar ka (core) temperature taqreeban ek jaisa rakhte hain. Jo janwar apna core temperature ek jaisa rakh sakte hain unhein homeotherms kehte hain.
Parindon ki chonch (bill) aur zubaan khane ki mukhtalif aadaton aur khurak ke hisaab se badli hui hoti hain: beej khane wale ki chonch moti aur keere khane wale ki patli hoti hai.

Parindon ka jism streamlined aur takli (spindle) jaisa hota hai. Agle limbs (forelimbs) wings ban gaye hain. Haddiyon mein hawa ki bari jagahen hoti hain, is liye yeh halki hoti hain. Daanton ki jagah ek halka ghilaaf hota hai jise bill (chonch) kehte hain. Seene ki haddi (sternum) par ek bari haddi, keel, hoti hai jis se urne ke muscles jure hote hain.

Bohat se parindon mein oesophagus ki ek thaili (diverticulum), crop, khana jama karti hai, taake parinda jaldi se bohat sa khana nigal sake. Stomach ka ek hissa, gizzard, muscular deewaron se khane ko peesta hai. Dil chaar chambers ka hai, jis mein atria aur ventricles poori tarah alag hain. Parindon ka nervous system bohat achha bana hai. Zyada tar parindon ke liye dekhna (vision) aur sunna (hearing) sab se aham hiss (senses) hain.

Bahar ke nathne (external nares) naak ke raston se pharynx mein khulte hain. Pharynx se trachea aur phir bronchi tak rasta jata hai. Awaaz ka organ, syrinx, trachea ke nichle sire par hota hai. Bronchi hawa ki thailiyon (air sacs) ke ek complex system tak jati hain, jo jism ke bare hisse mein phaili hoti hain aur kuch haddiyon ke andar tak jati hain. Air sacs lungs se juri hoti hain; lungs hawa ki chhoti naliyon (parabronchi) se bane hote hain.

Reptiles aur mammals ki tarah birds ke bhi amniotic eggs hote hain jin mein bohat sa yolk aur albumin hota hai. Parindon ke ande par sakht, calcium carbonate ka khol (hard calcareous shell) hota hai. Birds mein fertilization internal aur development jism ke bahar (external) hoti hai, yani yeh oviparous hain. Kuch parindon ne baad mein urne ki taqat kho di; inhein running birds (daurne wale parinde) kehte hain, jaise shuturmurgh (ostrich), kiwi, rhea, cassowary aur emu. Urne wale parinde: kabootar (pigeon), tota (parrot), kawwa (crow), uqaab (eagle), robin wagaira.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke parindon ke ande par chamre jaisa (leathery) khol hota hai. Yeh sahi nahi: parinde ke ande ka khol sakht hota hai aur zyada tar calcium carbonate ka bana hota hai (murghi ka anda dekhein). Chamre jaisa narm khol bohat se reptiles, jaise saanp aur aksar chhipkaliyon, ke andon par hota hai.
7. Class Mammalia

Mammalia un vertebrates ka group hai jo maa ke mammary glands ke doodh se palte hain aur jin ke jism par baal (hair) hote hain. Mammals ki jild mein glands hote hain jo epidermis se bante hain. Sebaceous (oil) glands tel jaisa maadda nikalte hain. Sudoriferous (sweat, paseene ke) glands paani jaisa maadda nikalte hain jo bhaap ban kar jism ko thanda karta hai (evaporative cooling). Mammary glands maada mammals mein kaam karte hain. Zyada tar mammals ki zindagi mein daanton ke do sets hote hain: doodh ke daant aur pakke (permanent) daant. Bahar ka kaan, pinna, hota hai. Darmiyani kaan (middle ear) mein teen haddiyon ki zanjeer hoti hai: incus, malleus aur stapes. Mammals endothermic aur homoeothermic hain. In ka dil chaar chambers ka hai. Ek muscular diaphragm coelom ko seene (thoracic) aur pait (abdominal) ki cavities mein baant deta hai. Awaaz ka system achhi tarah bana hai: larynx (vocal cords ke saath) aur epiglottis. Mammals mein fertilization internal hai. Mammals ke teen groups hain:

Zyada tar mammals (placental mammals) bachon ko janam dete hain, yani viviparous hain. Kuch mammals ande dete hain, is liye oviparous hain. Aur kuch marsupials hain (kitab ka yeh jumla adhoora chhapa hai; marsupials ka bayan neeche number 2 mein hai).

items: Ande dene wale mammals aise ande dete hain jin ke andar embryo ki poori development hoti hai. Yeh mammals Australia mein milte hain, jaise duckbill platypus aur echidna (spiny anteater).

Kuch mammals (marsupials) ki maada ke pait par ek thaili (pouch), marsupium, hoti hai. Yeh adhoore (immature) bachon ko janam dete hain jo maa ki thaili mein apni development poori karte hain. Yeh viviparous (zinda bachay dene wale) hain. Misaalein: opossum, kangaroo aur Tasmanian wolf.

Placental mammals sab se zyada taraqqi yafta (advanced) mammals hain. Development ke dauran maa ke uterus ki deewar aur foetus (pait ke bachay) ke jism ke darmiyan ek banawat banti hai jise placenta kehte hain. Isi placenta se foetus ko ghiza milti hai aur us ka fuzla nikalta hai. Misaalein: dolphin, chooha (rat), bandar (monkey), chamgadar (bat), haathi (elephant) aur insaan.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab marsupials ko ovoviviparous kehti hai. Yeh sahih nahin. Ovoviviparous janwar (maslan kuch sharks aur saanp) anda jism ke andar rakhte hain aur bacha ande ki zardi (yolk) se ghiza leta hai. Marsupials mein bacha maa ke uterus mein ek mukhtasar placenta (yolk-sac placenta) ke zariye maa se ghiza leta hai aur zinda paida hota hai, phir thaili (pouch) mein bara hota hai. Is liye marsupials viviparous hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Vertebrates do groups mein: Pisces (limbs nahi; 3 classes) aur Tetrapoda (chaar limbs; 4 classes).

Cyclostomata: jawless, scales nahi, cartilage. Chondrichthyes: cartilage, placoid scales, spiracle, swim bladder nahi, internal fertilization. Osteichthyes: haddi, operculum, swim bladder, gills ke chaar jore.
Amphibia: gardan, nam jild, teen chambers ka dil, pehle gills phir lungs aur jild, ectotherm, hibernate.
Reptilia: pehla amniotic egg (amnion, allantois, chorion; leathery calcareous khol), khushk scales wali jild, atlas aur axis, adhoora bata ventricle, oviparous.
Aves: feathers, endotherm aur homeotherm, wings, halki haddiyan, bill, keel, crop aur gizzard, chaar chambers ka dil, syrinx, air sacs aur parabronchi; sakht khol wale ande, oviparous.
Mammalia: doodh aur baal, jild ke glands, daanton ke do sets, pinna aur kaan ki teen haddiyan, chaar chambers ka dil, diaphragm, larynx; ande dene wale, marsupials aur placental mammals.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si classes ka dil chaar chambers ka hai, aur janwaron ka kaun sa group sab se pehle amniotic eggs wala tha?
blocks.explanation: Aves aur Mammalia ka dil chaar chambers ka hai, jis mein atria aur ventricles poori tarah alag hain. Reptilia pehla group tha jis mein amniotic eggs thay.
